parts.name: Leg (Left Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of metal, slender and elongated, typically around 13 cm long.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the glasses on the wearer’s ear and helps maintain stability and comfort.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around the hinge joint to fold inward or outward for storage or wearing.

parts.name: Leg (Right Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of metal, similar in size and shape to the left leg.
parts.Functional_description: It provides balance and support on the opposite side of the wearer’s head, ensuring the glasses stay in place.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around the hinge joint to fold inward or outward for storage or wearing.

parts.name: Base Body (Frame and Lenses)
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the eyeglasses, including the frame and lenses. The frame is metallic, and the lenses are made of optical-grade plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the lenses in position and provides the main optical function of vision correction or sun protection.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and rigid, serving as the central structure to which the legs are attached.
